stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved within Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Speed improvements reach up to 90% faster when utilized with coding agents, as validated by the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in the MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher output quality, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for building personal AI agents.
The key feature is the ability for these agents to run locally on the user's own hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, integrating local LLM execution.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance optimization.
The integration specifically targets Apple Silicon hardware, promising faster local AI inference.
This is currently available in a preview state, indicating ongoing development and optimization.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed to integrate with messaging applications.
It utilizes local AI coding agents, emphasizing on-device processing for privacy and control.
The core value proposition is running AI functionality entirely on the user's own hardware.

stories.title: Big Tech accused of stonewalling European social media researchers
stories.author: Anna Desmarais, wired.com
bullet_points: Major social media platforms (TikTok, X, Meta) are facing accusations of non-compliance with data requests.
Researchers claim the tech giants are stonewalling efforts to access legally required data.
The issue highlights ongoing regulatory friction between Big Tech and European researchers regarding data access.

stories.title: 3D-Aware VLMs with Implicit and Explicit Geometries
stories.author: Gongjie Zhang
bullet_points: Addresses a key limitation in current Vision-Language Models (VLMs): poor performance in 3D tasks due to reliance on 2D inputs.
Introduces VLM-IE3D, a unified framework designed to enhance 3D spatial awareness in VLMs.
Achieves this enhancement by integrating both implicit and explicit 3D geometries, utilizing novel Implicit Geometry Tokens (IGTs).

stories.title: GraphVid: Interactive Graph-Controllable Video Generation
stories.author: Ismini Lourentzou
bullet_points: GraphVid addresses the challenge of precise multi-object interaction control in video generation.
It overcomes limitations of text prompts and trajectory-based controls which struggle with complexity and occlusion.
The method utilizes a graph-based approach to enable flexible and precise control over multiple subjects in video generation.

stories.title: Beyond Sycophancy: Structured Resistance and Compliance in LLM Moral Reasoning
stories.author: Bernard Koch
bullet_points: Addresses the limitation of viewing LLM alignment solely as reducing sycophancy.
Proposes that socially calibrated LLMs must learn to distinguish between incorporating external views and maintaining independent moral judgment.
Identifies three structured dimensions governing how LLMs revise their judgments based on external input.

stories.title: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment
stories.author: Jianfeng Gao
bullet_points: Introduces OpenForgeRL, an open-source framework designed to train AI agents end-to-end.
Addresses the difficulty of training agents that rely on complex, stateful inference harnesses (like Claude Code/Codex) using standard open infrastructure.
Enables the training of harness-native agents across diverse environments, bridging the gap between complex agent architectures and open-source training stacks.

stories.title: 3D-Aware VLMs with Implicit and Explicit Geometries
stories.author: Gongjie Zhang
bullet_points: Addresses a key limitation in current 2D Vision-Language Models (VLMs) regarding 3D spatial understanding.
Introduces VLM-IE3D, a unified framework that integrates both implicit and explicit 3D geometries.
Utilizes Implicit Geometry Tokens (IGTs) to enhance the model's ability to capture high-level geometric priors from RGB videos.

stories.title: X$^3$-OPD: Distilling Reasoning into Large Audio-Language Models via On-Policy Alignment
stories.author: Tao Jin
bullet_points: Addresses the gap in deep logical reasoning capabilities of large audio-language models compared to text-based LLMs.
Introduces X$^3$-OPD, a cross-modal on-policy distillation framework for knowledge transfer.
Transfers reasoning capabilities from a strong text teacher model to an audio-language student model.

stories.title: DONDO: Open w2v-BERT Speech-Recognition Base Models for African Languages
stories.author: Paul Azunre
bullet_points: Introduction of DONDO, a family of open, permissively licensed ASR base models specifically for African languages.
The models are built upon the w2v-BERT 2.0 self-supervised speech encoder and cover 27 language varieties across several African nations.
Training data primarily consists of read speech from religious texts, ensuring broad and license-clear data availability.

stories.title: Windowed-MTP: Removing the Full-Context Draft-KV Tax at Million-Token Context
stories.author: Alagappan Valliappan
bullet_points: The paper addresses a critical performance bottleneck in speculative decoding when dealing with extremely long contexts (million tokens).
The issue arises because standard Multi-Token-Prediction (MTP) draft heads incur a linear cost by running full attention over the entire KV cache during each draft step.
Windowed-MTP proposes a solution to mitigate this 'Full-Context Draft-KV Tax,' making speculative decoding viable for massive context windows.

stories.title: GM Backs Sodium Ion Batteries for U.S. Grid Storage
stories.author: rbanffy
bullet_points: General Motors (GM) is investing in sodium-ion battery technology.
The focus of this adoption is for large-scale U.S. grid storage applications.
This signals a potential industry shift towards lower-cost, alternative battery chemistries for energy infrastructure.

stories.title: Android May Soon Restrict On-Device ADB, Affecting Shizuku, libadb and Developers
stories.author: kitsumed.github.io via raymii
bullet_points: Android is reportedly planning to restrict On-Device ADB access in future versions.
This change could significantly impact tools and frameworks like Shizuku and libadb.
The development community needs to prepare for potential limitations in debugging and advanced device interaction.

stories.title: I replicated the vision-only Pokémon run Anthropic showcased on the Fable 5 launch page — then I read its thinking chains
stories.author: qingze_hu_c4c251c1b353ede
bullet_points: The article verifies Anthropic's claim that Fable 5 can interact with Pokémon games using only visual input.
The author independently replicated the vision-only gameplay demonstrated on the Fable 5 launch page.
The analysis includes examining the underlying 'thinking chains' of the AI model.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release brings performance improvements and expanded GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to enhance model support across diverse hardware configurations.
It specifically augments Ollama's MLX engine for better performance on Apple silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for advanced AI capabilities within Claude Code.
The new features include the implementation of subagents for more complex task decomposition.
Web search functionality has been added, enhancing the model's ability to access real-time information.

stories.title: After backlash, Meta pauses plan to ‘rate limit’ its smart glasses
stories.author: Sean Hollister
bullet_points: Meta has halted its plan to implement a subscription fee for a feature on its smart glasses.
The feature in question allows users to hear each other more clearly and operates locally on the device.
The pause follows public backlash against the proposed monetization strategy.

stories.title: Meta just created a moderation nightmare for its smart glasses
stories.author: Mia Sato
bullet_points: Meta's smart glasses are facing significant public backlash regarding privacy concerns.
The devices are being misused by bad actors to film and 'prank' unsuspecting strangers.
There are specific reports of women becoming unwitting subjects of social media content filmed by users.

stories.title: SpaceX eyes tower catch for next Starship after auspicious end to 13th flight
stories.author: Stephen Clark
bullet_points: SpaceX plans to attempt a 'tower catch' recovery for the next Starship flight.
This recovery attempt follows the conclusion of the 13th Starship flight.
The focus remains on achieving a successful, controlled landing/catch for the vehicle.

stories.title: Anthropic's Opus 5 is about token efficiency, not a capability leap
stories.author: Samuel Axon
bullet_points: Anthropic's Opus 5 update is primarily focused on improving token efficiency rather than introducing massive new capabilities.
The article suggests that current, more cost-effective AI models are often sufficient for many use cases.
This signals a trend in the AI market where efficiency and cost-effectiveness are becoming as important as raw performance leaps.

stories.title: Roku raises streaming stick prices by up to 60 percent
stories.author: Scharon Harding
bullet_points: Roku is significantly increasing the prices of its streaming sticks by up to 60%.
The company attributes the price hike to a shortage of RAM.
The announcement contrasts with a recent positive outlook from the CEO regarding business performance.

stories.title: Beyond Sufficiency: Time Series Explanation with Counterfactual Necessity
stories.author: Weiru Liu
bullet_points: Introduces TimePNS, a new framework for explaining time-series classifiers.
Addresses a limitation in existing methods by incorporating 'necessity' alongside 'sufficiency' in explanations.
Aims to prevent spurious subsequences from being over-weighted in model explanations, drawing inspiration from counterfactual reasoning.

stories.title: MIRROR: Learning from the Other View for Multi-Modal Reasoning
stories.author: Xuezhe Ma
bullet_points: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show inconsistent visual reasoning capabilities compared to Large Language Models (LLMs).
The study highlights that different input views (text, diagram, combined) can elicit different behaviors in VLMs, even for equivalent problems.
The research suggests that these view-dependent inconsistencies point to complementary, but currently ununified, reasoning pathways within multimodal models.

stories.title: Expanding Flow Maps
stories.author: Pranam Chatterjee
bullet_points: Introduces Expanding Generative Flows (EFlows) to address limitations in existing flow-based generative models.
EFlows allow for generation across distributions of increasing dimensionality by augmenting the state with conditional noise.
The research aims to overcome constraints related to fixed dimensions or fixed sequence lengths in current generative models.

stories.title: Beyond Sufficiency: Time Series Explanation with Counterfactual Necessity
stories.author: Weiru Liu
bullet_points: Introduces TimePNS, a new framework for explaining time-series classifiers.
Addresses a limitation in current methods by moving beyond simple 'sufficiency' to incorporate 'necessity' in explanations.
Aims to prevent spurious subsequences from being over-weighted in model explanations, aligning with counterfactual reasoning.

stories.title: Graph Learning on Ensembles of Cyclic Peptides: An Investigation of Molecular Ensemble Modeling
stories.author: Maxim Secor
bullet_points: Introduces EnsembleEGNN, a foundation model designed to handle molecular conformational ensembles rather than single structures.
The model uses Equivariant Graph Neural Networks (EGNN) to encode individual conformers, followed by a Set Attention Block for ensemble pooling.
It is pre-trained on CREMP, a dataset specifically focused on cyclic peptide ensembles, targeting molecular property prediction.

stories.title: MIRROR: Learning from the Other View for Multi-Modal Reasoning
stories.author: Xuezhe Ma
bullet_points: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show inconsistent visual reasoning, even when equivalent information is presented in text, diagram, or combined formats.
The study, MIRROR, suggests that different input views expose complementary but sometimes conflicting reasoning capabilities within VLMs.
This highlights a key limitation in current multimodal AI, where performance isn't guaranteed across different data representations.

stories.title: The Boundaries of Automation: A Theory of Persistent Human Participation
stories.author: Iryna Gurevych
bullet_points: The paper challenges the prevailing assumption that human involvement in AI is solely due to current system limitations.
It shifts the focus from 'how far automation can extend' to identifying the conceptual limits of automation.
The core argument is that human participation may remain necessary even when AI systems achieve high levels of capability.

stories.title: MedGame: Storytelling Gamification Empowered by Large Language Models for Medical Education
stories.author: Qi Dou
bullet_points: Introduces MedGame, a framework that uses LLMs to transform static clinical cases into interactive, decision-centered learning games.
Addresses a limitation in current LLM medical education tools, which often only handle localized interactions like Q&A instead of full case trajectories.
Features a dual-engine design, including a Medical Narrative Designer, to structure complex clinical storytelling for educational purposes.

stories.title: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment
stories.author: Jianfeng Gao
bullet_points: OpenForgeRL is a new open-source framework designed to train AI agents end-to-end.
It addresses the difficulty of training agents that rely on complex, stateful inference harnesses (like Claude Code or Codex) using standard open infrastructure.
The framework enables harness-native agents to be trained across diverse and complex environments.

stories.title: GS-Agent: Creating 4D Physical Worlds With Generative Simulation
stories.author: Chuang Gan
bullet_points: The research addresses the challenge of generating dynamic, physically realistic 4D worlds from natural language descriptions.
Existing generative models struggle with ensuring the physical plausibility and controllability of the generated simulations.
The proposed GS-Agent aims to automate the creation of complex 4D environments, moving beyond manual computer graphics workflows.

stories.title: What, Where, and How: Disentangling the Roles of Task, Language, and Model in Code Model Representations
stories.author: Piotr Wilam
bullet_points: The research investigates how different language models (Qwen2.5-Coder-7B and DeepSeek-Coder-V1-6.7B) represent grammatical concepts across two programming languages (Python and Rust).
It uses a 2x2 design to disentangle the influence of the specific task, the programming language, and the underlying model architecture on code representation.
The study measures a comprehensive inventory of grammatical concepts to determine if independent models represent the same concepts in the same manner.

stories.title: Agentic coding without the cloud: evaluating open-weight large language models on longitudinal data preparation tasks
stories.author: David Bann
bullet_points: Addresses the privacy constraint of using cloud-based LLMs for code development involving sensitive data.
Proposes using locally deployable, open-weight LLMs as a solution to keep data on-premise.
Introduces an open-source framework to evaluate the performance of AI agents on longitudinal data preparation tasks.

stories.title: DeepSeek pause fundraise after comments on compute gap to US leaked (transcript) [pdf]
stories.author: oliculipolicula
bullet_points: DeepSeek paused its fundraise following comments regarding the compute gap between China and the US.
The news highlights ongoing geopolitical tensions impacting the AI industry's funding and development trajectory.
The leak of the transcript suggests internal strategic discussions about resource limitations in large-scale AI training.
